scope: runtime review, workflow and completion user guides, with separate evidence for delegated proponents, intake and miscellaneous concepts

changes.contract: Runtime reads require owning-scope Viewer access; source and ordinary item assignment do not replace that access. Exact approval read remains separate. Intake requires inherited Funding Case read. Proponent review list is filtered to readable schema agencies.
General reviewer lookup requires save authority; own-row reassignment lookup requires matching incomplete row, current read, row assignee, and unlocked review.

Paused workflow recovery requires ordinary exact-target update work authority before initiator/trigger actor or assignment-manager policy; extension replacement owners use declared eligible assignees. Assignment management alone cannot recover.

Role-permitted actions can remain visible when status, assignment or another prerequisite blocks action; choosing them warns without executing. Repeated recommendation definitions resolve by workflow occurrence and sequence.
Agreement review return stays on owning Agreement and defaults to its risk workspace; named route preserves localization and query state.
